diagram_candidates.claim: Each initial cohort moves on the exact characteristic a_i^{k+1}=a_i^k+Δt, loses survival mass, and may leave at cutoff A; each step inserts a newborn at age 0 with mass Δt B_h^k.
diagram_candidates.draw: Plot age a against time t with initial cohorts on lines a=a_i^0+t, the newborn boundary a=0 at each step, survival-mass labels, cutoff crossing/outflow at a=A, and labels for birth rate B_h^k. Distinguish discrete step updates from exact characteristic paths.

diagram_candidates.kind: characteristic regions in the time-age plane
diagram_candidates.claim: The density has an old-cohort branch for a≥t and a newborn branch for 0≤a<t, split along the diagonal a=t; newborns enter at the renewal boundary and survive along characteristics.
diagram_candidates.draw: Show the time-age quadrant, diagonal a=t, characteristic lines of slope one, initial-data contributions from t=0, boundary births from a=0, and the survival factors. Label which branch supplies each part of n(t,a), and the Volterra birth-rate relation.

diagram_candidates.claim: A transition (m,n) has a guard g_mn=0, signed crossing orientation σ_mn, and reset R_mn mapping the event state into the destination domain D_n; simultaneous first events use a fixed priority order.
diagram_candidates.draw: Use mode nodes m,n with within-mode flow y′=f_m(t,y), a directed edge labeled g_mn=0 and σ_mn·d(g_mn)/dt>0, and a reset arrow y(τ−)↦R_mn(τ,y(τ−)) in D_n. Add a small priority annotation for tied first guard zeros; avoid implying every trajectory has detected or finite events.

diagram_candidates.kind: multilevel time-grid and recursive correction schematic
diagram_candidates.claim: The recursive cycle partitions each level into F/C points, restricts residuals, solves recursively on the coarse level, prolongs corrections, and applies pre/post-relaxation; ν_ℓ controls recursive visits.
diagram_candidates.draw: Show nested time grids with C points aligned to the next coarser grid, F points between them, restriction R_ℓ of residuals, prolongation P_ℓ of correction, and the repeated recursive call ν_ℓ times. Mark exact coarsest solve and outer residual check. Keep transfers and coarse matrix labeled as supplied inputs.

diagram_candidates.claim: For F(x,λ)=x²−λ=0, the curve λ=x² folds at (0,0); the finite certified step starts at x=−α and reaches x=α+α²>0 across the fold using an x-directed pseudo-arclength section.
diagram_candidates.draw: Plot λ=x² with fold at (0,0), seed (−α,α²), positive-x tangent/predictor, transverse section x=α+α², and corrected root on the positive branch. Annotate λ′(0)=0 and that the claim is one finite local certified step, not global continuation.

diagram_candidates.claim: Small periodic orbits exist only for βℓ₁<0 with r²=−β/(ω₀ℓ₁)+O(|β|^{3/2}); the radial multiplier and transverse spectrum determine local stability under the stated conditions.
diagram_candidates.draw: Plot amplitude r≥0 against β, indicate only the local branch on βℓ₁<0 with leading square-root scaling, phase multiplier 1, radial multiplier μ_rad, and mark stability only when all transverse eigenvalues have the required sign. Label the sketch local and distinguish parameter orientation from the existence side.
